import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif
import seaborn as sns

def task_func(df1, df2):
    # Ensure inputs are pandas objects
    X = df1.copy() if isinstance(df1, pd.DataFrame) else pd.DataFrame(df1)
    y = df2.iloc[:, 0] if isinstance(df2, pd.DataFrame) and df2.shape[1] == 1 else df2
    if isinstance(y, pd.DataFrame):
        y = y.squeeze()
    if isinstance(y, pd.Series):
        y = y.values

    # Keep only numeric columns for feature selection
    X_num = X.select_dtypes(include="number")
    if X_num.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("df1 must contain at least one numeric feature.")

    k = min(2, X_num.shape[1])
    selector = SelectKBest(score_func=f_classif, k=k)
    selector.fit(X_num, y)

    selected_features = X_num.columns[selector.get_support()].tolist()

    # Correlation heatmap for the selected features
    corr = X_num[selected_features].corr()
    ax = sns.heatmap(corr, annot=True, cmap="coolwarm", vmin=-1, vmax=1)

    return selected_features, ax
